features.name: Centralized Document Repository
features.description: Allows authorized users to upload plain text and CSV bank e-statements, storing them in a private Supabase Storage bucket ('text-files') and saving file names, size, content, and uploader IDs to the database.

features.name: Postgres Full-Text Search (FTS)
features.description: Provides instant search capabilities across statement names and file contents using PostgreSQL GIN indexation to handle searches across multiple months and years of statements.

features.name: Shared Subdomain Session Client
features.description: Seamlessly integrates with the shared wild-card cookie session ('veryresto-auth') across base subdomains (.veryresto.com or .localtest.me) using a custom CookieStorage client-side adapter.

features.name: Centralized Identity Gate & Redirects
features.description: Enforces platform-level authentication. Redirects unauthenticated users to community-portal for OAuth, and sends users back to the central portal waiting room if they lack platform approval.

features.name: Namespaced Permissions Enforcement
features.description: Queries the shared public.has_namespaced_permission RPC to check for app-specific read ('ipl_finder.read_files') and write ('ipl_finder.upload_files') capabilities, decoupling access control from local logic.

features.name: Activity Logging & Realtime Audit Feed
features.description: Tracks operations such as document downloads. Automatically logs actions to the database and uses Supabase Realtime Channels to feed live activity logs into the admin view.

features.name: Bulk Statement Management
features.description: Enables administrators to bulk-select multiple statement files and delete them simultaneously from both Supabase Storage and database tables.

pages.name: Document Browser & SSO Gateway
pages.description: Main screen containing the file index, text search engine, upload triggers, and single-file/bulk-file actions. Handles redirects for unauthenticated and unapproved users.

pages.name: Admin Realtime Activity Audit Log
pages.description: Audit page displaying a live feed of file download events and administrative actions. Accessible only to users holding administrator privileges.

pages.name: Not Found Screen
pages.description: Fallback page displayed when a user navigates to an unrecognized path.

apis.name: Supabase Storage API (text-files)
apis.description: Private bucket storing the raw uploaded statement text files. Read/Write access is protected using storage RLS policies bound to 'ipl_finder.read_files' and 'ipl_finder.upload_files' permissions.

apis.name: public.has_namespaced_permission
apis.description: Shared RPC query checking if a user possesses the requested namespaced capability ('ipl_finder.read_files' or 'ipl_finder.upload_files'). Inherently returns true for global admins.

apis.name: delete-users
apis.description: Edge function that allows administrators to permanently delete users from auth.users (cascades to public tables), preventing self-deletion and other-admin-deletion.

apis.name: get-users-auth-info
apis.description: Edge function retrieving authentication dates and last sign-in metadata from the admin auth catalog.

apis.name: send-notification-email
apis.description: Edge function using Resend API to notify admins about new registrations and notify residents of approval/rejection changes.

database_tables.name: public.files
database_tables.description: Stores document metadata and extracted text contents for full-text search.

database_tables.name: public.activity_logs
database_tables.description: Immutable ledger logging download operations and system actions.

database_tables.name: public.profiles
database_tables.description: Ecosystem-wide profile catalog. Read by IPL Finder to display uploader details and list activity profiles.

database_tables.name: public.user_app_roles
database_tables.description: Maps users to application-specific roles ('resident', 'admin', or 'rejected' marker role).

database_tables.name: public.app_roles
database_tables.description: Defines role templates for registered apps.

background_jobs.name: update_files_updated_at
background_jobs.description: Triggers on files table modification to auto-maintain the updated_at timestamp metadata.

background_jobs.name: on_auth_user_created
background_jobs.description: Shared trigger running public.handle_new_user() to initialize profile records on user signup.

background_jobs.name: on_profile_created_assign_admin
background_jobs.description: Shared trigger running public.assign_admin_role() to assign default admin access privileges to veryresto@gmail.com on profile creation.
